verdict.rationale: Airweave confirms metadata filtering (CLI --filter by source, entity type, date) and multiple search modes (instant vector search vs. agentic multi-strategy search with tool calling), giving developers some control over retrieval beyond a single fixed similarity search. However, there is no explicit documentation of hybrid/keyword search modes or a dedicated reranking step/parameter. Missing for 10: explicit keyword/BM25 or hybrid search mode, explicit reranking configuration, independent benchmarking of these controls.
